## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login works end to end on staging with Fernhill's IdP: the short opaque RelayState (Redis, 10 min TTL) replaced the too-long return URL, JIT creates users as `viewer`, and group-to-role mapping is committed and open in PR #421, waiting on Fernhill IT to add the `groups` claim before Thursday's 10:00 NY demo. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-11)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" open; default role stays `viewer`, SP-initiated stays on, awaiting Fernhill IT's groups claim (source: ses-sso-3, s3-06, s3-07)
- [prochaine-étape] Fernhill IT adds the `groups` claim to their IdP (they said they will email), then review/merge #421 and run the Thursday demo with `kestrel.test1` plus one admin account (source: ses-sso-3, s3-05, s3-08, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] demo Thursday 10:00 New York (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes311)
- [décision] default role for new SAML users is `viewer`, least privilege (source: s1-05, s3-07)
- [décision] SP-initiated login stays on for Fernhill (source: s3-07)
- [décision] JIT only from verified domains; unverified domains refused and logged without email (source: s2-03)
- [décision] SAML 2.0 only, no OIDC for now (source: s1-03)
